interpretation_limits: Predeclared literal-span checks, not LLM answer accuracy. Equivalent alternative evidence can be undercounted.
Small deliberately selected diagnostic corpus; not representative or a ranking of memory systems.
Graph uses automatic surface-form co-occurrence, not a full Graphiti or HippoRAG implementation.
One prepared embedding model; no conclusion about every semantic model.
Methods share a small parent fixture/graph process. Sampled RSS is not incremental per-method memory.
Current semantic adapter starts a cold process and fingerprints the model per query; resident-model timings are reported separately.
Equal-score ties use opaque IDs derived from source roots; roots can change ties.
Curated memory is rejected by the current semantic pilot, not a supported policy feature.
